doc: Music v2 for the second cut: one 90.000 s track, 45 bars at 120 BPM, bar 1 beat 1 at 0.000 (film 0:28). Bar map from the lead, 2026-11-10. Chunk boundaries sit on the bar map; the short silences (bar 5, bar 17 beat 4, 53.5-54.5 s, bars 39-40) are cut in music_v2_conform.py, not asked of the model. Lessons from v1 (music.json plan_notes): name absences, use 'just', lower context_adherence for contrasting chunks.

chunks.name: rebirth
positive: starts on the first beat with a deep sub-bass hit
just a soft kick and a warm sub bass on A
a sparse pulse that slowly rises
a short riser that stops dead

chunks.name: drop
chunks.text:
[Drop]
{everything comes in on the first beat: a soft punchy kick, a warm bass line, warm pads and a short plucked theme high up; a short lift on the last beat}
positive: full groove from the first beat
a short plucked synth theme in a high register
a short lift on the last beat

chunks.name: problem
chunks.text:
[Breakdown]
{just a quiet ticking pulse on every beat like a clock, a deep sub and a low dark pad; no melody and no kick; the tension rises very slowly; it stops dead on the last beat}
positive: just a quiet ticking pulse on every beat like a clock
stops dead on the last beat

chunks.name: solution
chunks.text:
[Groove returns]
{the groove comes back on the first beat, brighter and warmer: soft kick, warm bass, warm chords A minor, F, C, G, soft plucks}
positive: the groove returns on the first beat
chords A minor F C G

chunks.name: breath
chunks.text:
[Breath]
{just a soft pad and a soft kick for one bar; then the groove comes back lightly with a small lift}
positive: just a soft pad and a soft kick
a small lift at the end

chunks.name: proof
chunks.text:
[Proof]
{a focused, minimal pulse with a little suspense: a soft kick, a deep sub, a ticking pulse and a low pad; it stops dead near the end}

chunks.name: resolve
chunks.text:
[Resolve]
{a warm resolving chord on the first beat, then the soft minimal pulse goes on}
positive: a warm resolving chord on the first beat

chunks.name: ghost
chunks.text:
[Ghost mode]
{the first bar thins to just a soft pad and a low pulse; then the groove rebuilds over two bars with an airy shimmer}
positive: first bar just a soft pad and a low pulse

chunks.name: access
chunks.text:
[Access]
{the groove with a clear soft kick on every beat, steady like a clock}
positive: a clear soft kick on every beat

chunks.name: lift
chunks.text:
[Lift]
{the biggest moment: the full theme and wide warm chords opening up like a sunrise}
positive: the biggest moment of the track

chunks.name: strip
chunks.text:
[Strip back]
{just a soft pad and the theme played softly for two bars, no drums; then it stops dead; then silence}
positive: just a soft pad and the theme played softly

chunks.name: end
chunks.text:
[Final chord]
{one warm resolving A minor chord with an added ninth on the first beat, sustained and slowly fading to nothing}
positive: one warm resolving chord on the first beat
A minor with an added ninth
